# B3 I2 evidence: source-mapped runtime diagnostics

Branch: `muse/closeout/b3` (uncommitted, per instructions). Packet: `/tmp/b3-scope-2.md` §c.

## What was built

- **NEW `packages/cloudflare/src/runtime/sourcemap.ts`** — `decodeMappings(mappings)`
  and `lookup(map, genLine, genCol)`, pure, workerd-safe, zero deps. Mirrors the
  Rust decoder (`compiler/src/codegen/sourcemap.rs`: 1-/4-/5-field segments,
  per-line `genCol` reset, cross-line `prev_*` accumulation) and consumes the
  `SourceMap` contract from `contracts/src/artifact.ts` (`import type`). Decoded
  positions are 0-based; `lookup` returns 1-based `{source, line, column, name?}`.
  Malformed `mappings` throws a loud `sourcemap:` error; unknown frames return `null`.
- **`runtime/modules.ts`** — `assembleModules` now stages `<mod>.map` beside each
  `<mod>.js`, appends a trailing `//# sourceMappingURL=` comment (after the last
  emitted line, so generated line numbers stay valid), and returns additive
  `mapUrls` alongside `moduleUrls` (optional field, so hand-built assemblies compile).
- **`runtime/invoke.ts`** — handler throws now capture `Error.stack` and attach
  additive `mapped?: {source, line, column}` to `InvokeResult`. Single top-down
  scan: the first generated-module frame resolves via `lookup`; the first
  runtime-remapped frame (Node with source-map support rewrites the file to the
  map's `sources` entry) carries the 1-based `.can` position directly. New exported
  pure helpers `findAssembledFrame` (exact URL/path, then longest `/<module>` suffix
  for realpath divergence e.g. macOS `/tmp` vs `/private/tmp`) and `findRemappedFrame`.
  Mapping never throws: any failure yields the original message-only result.
- **`dev/local-run.ts`** — optional `sourceMaps` (module name → V3 map) appended as
  inline `sourceMappingURL` data-URL comments; absent by default, modules untouched.
- **`testkit/src/reporting/report.ts`** — additive `FailureLocation`,
  `formatFailureLocation`, `withFailureLocation(entry, location)` (contracts report
  types carry no location field, so the location rides the `detail` string).
- **`compiler/tests/codegen.rs`** (append-only, +54/−0) — `sourcemap_emitted_fixture_plain_snippet`:
  plain 3-line snippet, no forms/policies, asserts exact bytes `AAAAA;AACA;AACA`,
  per-segment resolution, and the `to_json` shape.
- **NEW `packages/cloudflare/test/sourcemap.test.ts`** — 14 tests, all on a NON-EMPTY
  real map (`AAAA;AACA;AACA`, never `EMPTY_MAP`).

## Round-trip proof

Throwing handler (`throw` on generated line 3) + real map → invoke:

- staged `main.js.map` on disk holds the exact mappings; staged `main.js` carries
  `//# sourceMappingURL=main.js.map`; `mapUrls["main.js"]` is the map file URL;
- `invokeCallable` returns `{ ok: false, error: "kaboom", mapped: { source: "plain.can", line: 3, column: 1 } }`
  via **both** paths: runtime-remapped frames (vitest/vite-node applies the staged map)
  and invoke's own `lookup` (proven by deleting the staged map + comment so the stack
  keeps generated positions).
- Unknown frames (empty map) and malformed maps (`"!"`) stay message-only
  (`error: "kaboom"`, `mapped` absent); the failure is loud at the decode layer
  (`decodeMappings`/`lookup` throw `/sourcemap/i`) and the unmapped generated
  position stays extractable via `findAssembledFrame`.
